title: The Hindenburg Burned in Just 34 Seconds

scenes.text: A giant airship burned up in thirty-four seconds.
The Hindenburg was 804 feet long, longer than two football fields.
On May 6, 1937, it caught fire while landing in New Jersey.
It was filled with over seven million cubic feet of hydrogen.
Ninety-seven people were on board, and sixty-two survived.
Thirty-four seconds. That's all it took.

description:
The Hindenburg airship was 804 feet long and burned in about 34 seconds on May 6, 1937.
Of the 97 people on board, 62 survived.
Would you have flown on an airship?
